title: Local Softmax and Global Weights in Non-Boolean Event Structures
summary: Softmax and related normalized response functions are widely used in choice theory, machine learning, and cognitive science. In non-Boolean event structures with overlapping contexts, however, local normalization does not automatically yield a global probability weight. We show that imposing single-valuedness on shared atoms -- equivalently, no-disturbance or consistent connectedness -- collapses generalized softmax rules to coordinate parametrizations of the strictly positive part of the admissible-weight polytope.
